title: Elux Firerose 5000 Blue Crush 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blue Crush from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection of outstanding Nic Salt flavours is a refreshing delight for vapers who love the marriage of fruit and cool sensations. Its primary flavour is a rich and authentic blueberry, bringing the deep, natural sweetness and slightly tangy notes of this beloved berry to the forefront. The blueberries' juicy profile is enhanced by an icy touch, creating a sensation akin to enjoying a frozen blueberry smoothie on a hot day. The addition of the ice element transforms the vaping experience, adding a crisp and revitalising finish to the lush blueberry taste. This combination creates a vape that's both satisfying in its fruity richness and invigorating in its bracing freshness. It's an ideal choice for those seeking a flavour that's both comforting in its familiarity and exhilarating in its execution. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
